clip_key: # Voyage radio on entering a sphere of influence (event soi_enter, topic home for Kerbin). New keys: vo_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

english: Welcome. This is {body}.
Thanks. Where do we leave the luggage? | Thanks. Where do we leave the luggage? | Thanks. Where does the luggage go?
Crew, {body} welcomes you.

spanish: Qué amable. Pero no he visto ningún cartel.
english: How kind. But I didn't see a sign. | How kind. But I didn't see a sign. | Nice. I missed the sign, though.
Control, where are we now? | Control, where are we now? | Control, where are we?

spanish: Según el mapa, eso de ahí es {body}.
english: According to the map, that over there is {body}.
{body} is right ahead. Get your passports ready.

spanish: Mi pasaporte se quedó en la plataforma.
english: My passport stayed on the launchpad. | My passport stayed on the launchpad. | I left my passport on the launchpad.
Attention: {body} says hello. Behave yourselves.

spanish: Siempre nos portamos bien. Casi siempre.
english: We always behave. Almost always. | We always behave. Almost always. | We behave. Mostly.
Arrival confirmed. {body} is in charge now.

spanish: Entendido. Saludaremos a la nueva gravedad.
english: Understood. We'll say hi to the new gravity. | Understood. We'll say hi to the new gravity. | Copy. Hello, new gravity.

spanish: La guía dice que en esta época {body} merece la pena.
english: The guidebook says {body} is worth it this time of year.

spanish: ¿Y quién escribió la guía? Nadie ha venido nunca.
english: And who wrote the guidebook? Nobody has ever been here. | And who wrote the guidebook? Nobody has ever been here. | Who wrote the guidebook? Nobody's been here.
Take lots of photos of {body}.

spanish: Vale. Pero todas van a salir movidas.
english: Okay. But they'll all come out blurry. | Okay. But they'll all come out blurry. | Fine. They'll all be blurry.
Hello! Anybody home? | Hello! Anybody home? | Hello! Is anyone home?
{body} isn't answering. Leave a message.
New neighbor in sight: {body}.

spanish: Voy a saludar con las dos manos.
english: I'm going to wave with both hands. | I'm going to wave with both hands. | Waving with both hands.
Welcome home, crew. | Welcome home, crew. | Welcome back home, crew.

spanish: Por fin. Huele a césped desde aquí.
english: Finally. I can smell the grass from here. | Finally. I can smell the grass from here. | At last. I can smell the grass.
Control, we can see home. | Control, we can see home. | Control, home is in sight.
Welcome back. There's hot soup waiting. | Welcome back. There's hot soup waiting. | Welcome back. Hot soup is waiting.
Welcome home. Did you bring anything? | Welcome home. Did you bring anything? | Welcome back. Souvenirs?

spanish: Datos, fotos y un poco de polvo en las botas.
english: Data, photos and some dust on our boots. | Data, photos and some dust on our boots. | Data, photos and dusty boots.
